corrections_and_findings.claim: brief: PostgreSQL has a WAIT FOR LSN feature
corrections_and_findings.finding: Only in PostgreSQL 19 (beta 4, 2026-09-24); version 18 has none. Stated so in section 3.

corrections_and_findings.claim: CockroachDB follower_read_timestamp() is 4.8 s in the past (function reference, unlicensed)
corrections_and_findings.finding: Measured 4.2 s on this unlicensed v26.3.0 cluster, matching the follower-reads page's 'at least 4.2 seconds'. Both shown.

corrections_and_findings.claim: Aurora DSQL lacks foreign keys (commonly repeated)
corrections_and_findings.finding: Current docs list foreign key support; not stated as missing on the page.

corrections_and_findings.claim: Postgres insert latency 0.14 ms against CockroachDB 23 ms
corrections_and_findings.finding: Unfair as is: macOS fsync does not force the drive cache, CockroachDB (Go, F_FULLFSYNC) does. Postgres with fsync_writethrough measured 5.1 ms median; both shown.
Measured: a plain index on created_at gives 23 ms against 26 ms for the pruned monthly layout; partitioning's main win is retention (DROP 0.021 s and 0.16 MB WAL against DELETE 2.1 s and 160 MB).
